Has a chance to give [[FES Gobbie Key]]s once per day throughout the holiday period. Trading items that horses like (San d'Orian Carrots, Faerie Apples) has a higher chance of receiving a reward. {{Spoiler2}} [[category:Seasonal Event NPCs]]
